$comment: Central registry mapping each agent (filename stem, no .md) to its model tier. Source agent .md files are model-free; the deploy-time resolver (resolve-models.mjs) reads this to inject a concrete model. Tiers: reasoning (correctness-critical), fast (exploratory/low-impact), docs (text/lint/reporting), vision (native multimodal), long-context (large-context research loops — shares the primary model's 1M ctx but is the designated subagent tier for autoresearch loops; subagents never use the `primary` tier directly). NOTE (#294): image-analyzer-subagent and error-resolver-subagent BOTH live on the `vision` tier (native multimodal zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3-flash, natively mapped by models.dev — verified 2026-08-27) — they see images/screenshots directly, no external vision API. glm-5v-turbo is no longer custom-registered under zai-coding-plan; text-only sessions fall back to the inline direct-API recipe embedded in image-analyzer-subagent (glm-5v-turbo via the pay-as-you-go `zai` path). NOTE (#357): zai-media-subagent joins the vision tier (media generation orchestration; generation endpoints are PAYG, vision perception is native). NOTE (#372): uiux-reviewer-subagent joins the vision tier — UI/UX review is vision-heavy (screenshot evidence at 3 breakpoints), so it reads screenshots natively (glm-5.3-flash) instead of the text-only reasoning model; image-analyzer-subagent delegation remains as fallback per the hybrid rule in its agent file.
